name: _chrome.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_chrome.scss — the .docs portal chrome — container flex column + the GL thread backdrop and persistent 3D architecture scene layers.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
  line-height: 1.6;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;

  // ── GL thread backdrop + persistent 3D architecture scene ────────────
  // Both are fixed, viewport-sized layers behind the content column —
  // the scene stays mounted on every docs page so folder navigation is
  // always available (orbit/pinch on exposed areas, tap-to-pick).
  &-gl,
  &-scene {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 0;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }

  &-gl {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  // The scene needs pointer events where the content column leaves it
  // exposed — OrbitControls owns rotate/pinch, taps pick nodes. Ink is
  // the project's turquoise accent *contrast* variant: cyan on dark,
  // deep teal on light — the raw accent is invisible on white.
  &-scene {
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    cursor: grab;

    &:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
  }

  // Scene caption — a faint fixed chip in the bottom gutter naming the
  // backdrop ("architecture map") so first-time viewers know it is the
  // interactive folder navigator, not decoration. pointer-events: none
  // keeps the scene draggable under it.
  &-scene-hint {
    position: fixed;
    right: to-rem($space-md);
    bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    // Above the z-index:1 content column — body sits later in DOM order
    // and would paint over the chip's left half on file pages.
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
    padding: to-rem($space-3xs) to-rem($space-sm);
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 88%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-contrast) 35%, transparent);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  // CSS fallback: soft drifting gradient band when WebGL is off.
  &-gl-fallback &-gl {
    background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, currentColor 45%, transparent 60%);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    opacity: 0.04;
    animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-drift 18s linear infinite;
  }

  @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-drift {
    from {
      background-position: 0% 0%;
    }
    to {
      background-position: 100% 100%;
    }
  }
}
